name: shape
description: Structural comparability gate -- deterministically answers whether two CSV datasets can be compared

arguments.name: old
arguments.description: Old CSV file (required for compare mode)

arguments.name: new
arguments.description: New CSV file (required for compare mode)

options.name: delimiter
options.description: Force CSV delimiter for both files

options.name: no_witness
options.description: Suppress ambient witness ledger recording for this compare run

options.name: capsule_dir
options.description: Write deterministic repro capsule artifacts to this directory (default off)

options.name: profile
options.description: Reserved in v0; parsed but check scoping is deferred

options.name: profile_id
options.description: Reserved in v0; parsed and echoed in JSON profile_id

options.name: lock
options.description: Reserved in v0; lock verification is deferred

options.name: max_rows
options.description: Reserved in v0; row-limit refusal is deferred

options.name: max_bytes
options.description: Reserved in v0; byte-limit refusal is deferred

options.name: explicit
options.description: Show column names and other identifying metadata in output (default: redacted for zero-retention safety)

options.name: schema
options.description: Print JSON Schema for shape.v0 output format and exit 0

options.name: describe
options.description: Print compiled operator.json and exit 0 without positional args

2.meaning: REFUSAL / CLI error / witness internal error

refusals.message: Unsupported encoding (UTF-16/32 BOM or NUL bytes)
One or both files are empty
